meta.title: SCRIPE Authorization, Feature-Permission & Internal RBAC Architecture

views.label: 1. Edge, Context & Feature Gate
views.note: TenantContextMiddleware resolves membership & drill-down before RequireMfaEnrollment and live IFeatureChecker PBAC.

views.label: 2. Feature Sync & Cache Eviction
views.note: All 16 publishers compute effective features via EffectiveFeatureMapBuilder, then commit before evicting caches.

views.label: 3. Multi-Role FLS & Exports
views.note: Read-preferred role FLS intersection unions with UserGroupRestrictions while preserving dotted resources across JSON & exports.

views.label: 4. SCRIPE 16-Role Internal Tenant
views.note: SCRIPE (scripe-internal) seeds 389 active perms across 16 roles & 10 UserGroups with zero PlatformOnly leaks.

boundaries.label: ASP.NET Core Zero-Trust Ingress & FLS Pipeline

components.label: Next.js 16 MVVM Portal
components.explanation: Enforces tenant isolation on SuperAdmin helpers (rejects username/substring elevation), overwrites empty [] principals, and scrubs restricted/sentinel fields before PUT/PATCH.

components.label: Roles & Restrictions Studio
components.explanation: Consumes tenant-filtered available permissions, hides all_tenants from tenant roles, supports dotted UserGroupRestrictions, and invalidates auth/entitlements/nav caches on save.

components.label: Tenant Context & MFA Gate
components.explanation: Passes unauthenticated calls through, warms AdminPermissionCache on cold starts, resolves DrillDown/Membership EffectivePermissions & EffectiveRestrictedFields, then enforces RequireMfaEnrollment.

components.label: Permission Authz Handler
components.explanation: Evaluates endpoint metadata & pat_scope, blocks PlatformOnly on tenant or membership sessions, and verifies live IFeatureChecker against IPermissionCatalogCache even on unexpired JWTs.

components.label: Permission Catalog Cache
components.explanation: Immutable singleton dictionary compiled from 19 IModulePermissionProviders supporting RequiredFeature, RequiredAnyFeatures (10), and IsGloballyAvailable (10) with fail-closed lookup.

components.label: Live Feature Checker
components.explanation: Applies Override > Edition > FeaturePackExpansion (Venue) > DefaultValue, resets IsMarketingOnly, and fails closed in HttpFeatureChecker on transport failure.

components.label: FLS Middleware & Behavior
components.explanation: Resolves canonical resource from [Resource] or single [PermissionRequired], masks JSON responses via FieldProjectionMiddleware, and blocks restricted write mutations.

components.label: Hardened Export & Download
components.explanation: Requires audit.export on Dashboard exports, enforces ICrmRecordVisibilityPolicy across CRM exports, neutralizes CSV formulas, blocks global Compliance/Subscription IDORs, and re-checks queued jobs.

components.label: Admin Security Service
components.explanation: Sorts AdminRoles ascending (Priority 0 = highest), filters active entitled RolePermissions, and computes effective permissions, scopes, and restricted fields.

components.label: FLS Merge Engine
components.explanation: Prefers read-capable roles when intersecting RestrictedFieldsJson across multiple roles, then unions active UserGroupRestriction overlays case-insensitively.

components.label: Resource Normalizer
components.explanation: Resolves canonical lowercase resource keys (crm.opportunities, finance.payments, employment-records) without naive Split('.')[0] truncation.

components.label: Authz & Principal Cache
components.explanation: PrincipalResponseCacheHelper invalidates 30s admin:principal:* keys atomically whenever AdminPermissionCache evicts by admin, role, or global stamp.

components.label: Tenant Permission Manager
components.explanation: Syncs TenantPermissions using IPermissionCatalogCache (blocking PlatformOnly and disabled modules, retaining IsGloballyAvailable), while preserving regular RolePermission rows across toggles.

components.label: Effective Feature Builder
components.explanation: Called by all 16 SubscriptionChangedEvent publishers after SaveChangesAsync; merges active/trialing Base & Add-On subscriptions without clobbering Tenant.EditionName.

components.label: Subscription & Cache Bus
components.explanation: Dispatches SubscriptionChanged, Canceled, Expired, Suspended, and Resumed events after DB commit so Entitlements never writes directly to Identity tables.

components.label: Identity Schema DB
components.explanation: Persists TenantPermissions, Roles, RolePermissions, UserGroups, UserGroupRestrictions, and AdminDelegations across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.

components.label: Entitlements Schema DB
components.explanation: Stores 190 Feature definitions, EditionFeatures (Tier-1 platform false, Tier-2 self-service true), Subscriptions, and TenantFeatureOverrides.

cards.title: Zero Module Coupling
items: Identity never references Entitlements; Entitlements never writes Identity tables
Core.Application owns IPermissionCatalogCache, IFeatureChecker, FeaturePackExpansion & PermissionResourceNormalizer
All 16 SubscriptionChangedEvent publishers respect TenantFeatureOverrides & Base EditionName

cards.title: Fail-Closed Defense-in-Depth
items: PermissionAuthorizationHandler checks live IFeatureChecker even on unexpired JWTs
HttpFeatureChecker fails closed (false/0) on transport exceptions

cards.title: SCRIPE Internal Tenant Invariants
items: 490 catalog perms -> 69 PlatformOnly blocked, 32 Plugins/Marketplace off, 389 active
16 Roles (Priority 0..900 ascending) & 10 UserGroups (zero all_tenants, zero passwords)
Read-preferred role FLS intersection + additive GRP_SCRIPE_PII_MASKED union
